Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) with an infection-related indication. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno and join compound_structures for canonical SMILES. Filter where max_phase_for_ind equals 4 and the indication label or mesh heading contains infection. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie (EFO ID), indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
